title: Payment
checkoutError: Couldn't start the payment. Please try again.
cancelled: You cancelled the payment; your order is waiting to be paid.

invalidLink.title: Invalid payment link
invalidLink.text: The link doesn't contain a valid order ID.

notFound.title: Payment not found
notFound.text: The payment for this order isn't available from this browser. If you have an account, log in with the email address you sent the package with.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: Couldn't load the payment status. Please refresh the page.

processing.title: Processing payment...
processing.text: Waiting for confirmation from your bank, this usually takes a few seconds.

PENDING.title: Awaiting payment
PENDING.text: Pay by card to send your package. We now hold at most {{maxAmount}} on your card; the final price is charged once the route is planned and the rest is released.

AUTHORIZED.title: Payment successful
AUTHORIZED.text: {{maxAmount}} is held on your card. The final price is charged once the route is planned, and the rest is released automatically. We'll send you a confirmation email.

PAID.title: Paid
PAID.text: The final price of the package ({{capturedAmount}}) has been charged.

EXPIRED.title: Payment deadline expired
EXPIRED.text: The order wasn't paid in time, so it wasn't sent. Please place a new order.

FAILED.title: Payment failed
FAILED.text: The payment didn't go through, so the order wasn't sent. Please place a new order.

CANCELED.title: Payment cancelled
CANCELED.text: The amount held on your card has been released; the order won't be delivered.

REFUNDED.title: Refunded
REFUNDED.text: The amount paid has been refunded to your card.
